threads.body: [Config] Removing this bean makes `FallbackConfigProperties` eligible in an enabled declarative context: it requires an `OpenTelemetry` bean and no `ConfigProperties` bean, but does not exclude declarative mode. It therefore recreates `otelProperties` using `DefaultConfigProperties`, so existing consumers silently read flat/default values instead of the active YAML. Add `@Conditional(DeclarativeConfigDisabled.class)` to the fallback so the compatibility bean is actually removed in declarative mode while remaining available for flat configuration.

replies.body:
Addressed in 2129f85384bc2c9799a79737f84c2698a89fd615.

Reproduced with DeclarativeConfigTest.customOpenTelemetry: the frozen implementation supplied otelProperties as DefaultConfigProperties despite otel.file_format being set. Adding @Conditional(DeclarativeConfigDisabled.class) prevents this flat fallback in declarative mode without changing the ConfigProvider fallback or flat configuration. Regression assertions cover both custom and auto-configured OpenTelemetry contexts; all 111 normal and 36 declarative tests pass.

@copilot Update this existing PR directly with both changes below. Do not create a follow-up PR as a workaround. Preserve the existing PR's draft state and its other changes.

1. In `instrumentation/spring/spring-boot-autoconfigure/src/main/java/io/opentelemetry/instrumentation/spring/autoconfigure/OpenTelemetryAutoConfiguration.java`, keep the SDK-disabled empty `ConfigProperties` bean for flat configuration, but stop providing it for declarative configuration. Move `otelProperties()`, which returns `DefaultConfigProperties.createFromMap(emptyMap())`, from `DisabledOpenTelemetrySdkConfig` into its existing `PropertiesConfig` nested class, which already has `@Conditional(DeclarativeConfigDisabled.class)`. Keep the disabled no-op `OpenTelemetry` and `ConfigProvider` beans available in both modes. Preserve the supported flat-mode bean and the declarative exclusion on `FallbackConfigProperties`.

2. In `CHANGELOG.md`, replace this PR's Spring Boot entry under the top breaking-changes heading with exactly: "Remove the Spring Boot starter-provided `ConfigProperties` bean in declarative mode, including when telemetry is disabled. Read configuration through `ConfigProvider` and `DeclarativeConfigProperties` instead." Wrap it according to the existing changelog style. Leave the separate entry about removing `DeclarativeConfigPropertiesBridge` and `DeclarativeConfigPropertiesBridgeBuilder` unchanged.

Add focused regression assertions to the existing normal and `testDeclarativeConfig` SDK-disabled tests. Flat mode with `otel.sdk.disabled=true` must retain an empty `otelProperties` bean of type `ConfigProperties`; declarative mode with `otel.file_format` present and `otel.disabled=true` must have neither a starter-provided `otelProperties` bean nor a `ConfigProperties` bean. Both disabled modes must still provide no-op `OpenTelemetry` and `ConfigProvider`. Existing enabled-mode behavior must remain unchanged. Run the narrowest applicable formatter and tests using the repository's documented commands. Do not add unrelated changes.
